children: RNS Number : 3371T  CVC Income & Growth Limited  03 September 2026

CVC Income & Growth Limited (the Company) announces that on 3 September 2026, it resold from treasury 1,500,000 Sterling shares for cash at a price of £1.1752 per Sterling share, to meet on-going demand for the Company's shares.
Following this issue, the Company's issued share capital (excluding treasury shares) will consist of:
·        215,751,817 ordinary Sterling shares of no par value; and
·        87,736,186 ordinary Euro shares of no par value.
Each ordinary Sterling share carries the right to 1.17 vote and each ordinary Euro share carries the right to 1 vote.

The total number of voting rights of the ordinary Sterling shares of no par value is 252,429,625 and of the ordinary Euro shares of no par value is 87,736,186. The total number of voting rights in the Company will be 340,165,811.
The Company will hold the following ordinary shares in treasury:
·        156,427,946 ordinary Sterling shares of no par value (non-voting); and
·        54,148,608 ordinary Euro shares of no par value (non-voting).

The figure, 340,165,811, may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculation by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in or a change to their interest in the company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
